_comment: Single source of truth for the videos. Edited by the studio at /studio/videos.html. The watch page fetches this file on load.

videos.title: New long-form talk
videos.blurb: A new long-form video on AI, decisions, and execution.

videos.title: The Learning Trap
videos.blurb: You don't have a learning problem. You have a thinking problem. Most ambitious people believe the next book, the next course, the next framework will finally unlock things. It won't.

videos.title: Your Dashboard is Lying to You
videos.blurb: The number on your dashboard is real. The story it tells you isn't. Most leaders optimise what they can see while the actual constraint hides in a handoff, an approval queue, or one overloaded person.
